questions.q: A hospital reports by phone that a pump alarm did not sound. What is this record called?
options: An engineering change order, since the alarm design must now be changed
questions.why: A complaint alleges a problem with a released device.

questions.q: Which rule covers electronic records and electronic signatures?
questions.why: Part 11 covers e-records, e-signatures and audit trails.

questions.q: Where is the evidence of how a device was designed, verified and validated collected?
questions.why: The DHF holds design control evidence; the DHR holds production records.

questions.q: Which standard covers risk management for medical devices?
questions.why: ISO 14971 sets the risk management process for devices.
CAPA finds the root cause, fixes it, prevents recurrence and checks the fix worked.

questions.q: A tool's evaluation set is written up with agreed acceptance criteria before the run. What is this work part of?
options: Validation under a risk-based approach such as CSA
Device classification, since it decides whether the tool is a medical device
questions.why: Objective evidence that a system meets its intended use is validation.
